paite: Huan Joab ahilh ua, "Ngai in, kumpipa’n kap in Absalom asuun hi," achi uh.
heading: Joab In David Amohsa
english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

paite: Huai ni a avualzohna uh mi tengteng a ding in suunna ahong hi zawta hi. "Atapa ziak in kumpipa alungkham mahmah," achih uh huai ni in mite'n lah ana zata ngal ua.
english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

paite: Mite kidouna a mi taimang azum ziak a aguk a paimang bang in huai ni in aguk in khopi ah alut uhi.
english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

paite: Kumpipa'n amai ahum a, "Aw, ka tapa Absalom, aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!" chi in kumpipa akap huphup hi.
english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

paite: Inn ah kumpipa kiang ah Joab alut a, "Na hinna, na tapate hinna, na tanute hinna, na zite leh na meite hinna humbit mite tuni in zumtak in na bawlta hi.
english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

paite: Nang hon hote na it a, nang hon itte na hua hi. Heutute leh sepaihte nang a dia bangmah hilou bang in tuni in na hihlangta hi. Absalom dam in, kou midang tengteng tuni in si zaw vek le ung, na kipah lamtak hileh kilawm in ka thei hi.
english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

paite: Huaiziak in thou inla, pawtkhia in. Na mite lungmuansak ding lam thu gen in. Na pawtkhiak keileh TOUPA min lou in ka kichiam hi. Mi khat lel leng tuzan in na kiang ah a-om kei ding. Huai lah nang a ding in na tuailai a pan tutan a na tung a thil hoih lou hong tung teng sang in ahoih kei zaw ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by Yahweh, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa athou a, kulh kongpi ah ava tu hi. "Ngai un, kumpipa kulh kongpi ah atu hi,” chi in mipi tengteng ahilh uhi. Mipi tengteng kumpipa ma ah ava hoh uhi. Israelte bel amau puanin chiat ah ataikek uhi.
english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

paite: Israel nam a mi tengteng akisel vengvung ua, "Kumpipa'n i melmate khut a pan hon hunkhia a, Philistiate khut a pan hon hondamta. Tu in Absalom ziak in gam ataikhiaksan hi.
heading: Jerusalem Ah David Akiknawn
english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

paite: Absalom i kumpipa dia thau i nilhpa uh lah kidouna ah asita a; bang achia kumpipa pikikna ding kam khat bek na gen louh uh?" akichi uh.
english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

paite: Kumpipa'n siampu Zadok leh Abiathar kiang ah asawl a, Judah upate kiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa a-inn a pikik thu a, azekaipen a pang na hi ua? Israel mite'n kumpipa pikik thu agen uh lah kumpipa kiang atungta ngal a.
english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

paite: Ка unaute na hi ua, ka guh leh ka sa lah na hi ngal ua, bang achia azekaipen a pang peuhmah na hi ua? chi in va gen un,” achi hi.
english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

paite: Amasa kiang ah, "Ka guh leh ka sa na hi kei a hia? Joab sik a ka ma a sepaihte heutu a ka hon bawl keileh, Pathian in alohloh hon loh mai henla, huai sang a thupizaw in leng, achi," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

paite: Huchi in Judah mi tengteng lungtang mi khat lungtang bang mai in a-awnsakta hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na mi tengteng toh hong kik nawn un," chi ding in mi asawl uhi.
english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa apai nawn a, Jordan ahong tung hi. Kumpipa dawn a, Jordan a na pi galkai ding in Gilgal ah Judahte ahoh uhi.
english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

paite: Hahurim a Benjamin mi Gera tapa Shimei leng kintak in kumpipa dawn ding in Judahte mah toh kiton in apawtkhia hi.
english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

paite: Akiang ah Benjamin mi sangkhat toh, Saul inkote sikha Ziba, atapa sawm-le-nga leh asikha sawmnih toh ahi ua, kumpipa ma in Jordan agalkah uhi.
english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

paite: Kumpipa inkote pi galkahna ding leh hoih asak bangbang a hih ding in long apaipih uh. Jordan lui agalkahleh kumpipa ma ah Gera tapa Shimei abokkhup hi.
english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah, "Ka toupa'n thulimlouhna nei in hon sep kei henla; toupa ka kumpipa'n Jerusalem apawtsan ni a na sikha in dikloutak a ana hihte leng theigige sam kei hen. Kumpipa'n alungtang ah pai kei hen.
heading: David In Shimei Tung ah Itna Alangsak
english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

paite: Na sikha in thil ka hihkhial chih ka kithei hi. Huaiziak in ngai in, Joseph inko tengteng lak a ka toupa kumpipa mu dia tuni a hong pawt masapen ka hi," achi hi.
english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

paite: Himahleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in adawng a, "TOUPA thaunilhpa ahamsiat ziak in Shimei pen thah ding ahi kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh’s anointed?”

paite: David in, "Nou Zeruiah tapate aw, nou na hon na theihsak ding uh bang ahia om? Tuni a kei hon doute na hi ding uh maw? Tuni a Israelte lak a mi thah ahi dia hia? Tuni in Israel mite tung a kumpipa ka hihthei lou ka hi maw?" achi hi.
english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

paite: Huaiziak in kumpipa'n Shimei kiang ah, "Na si kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in Kumpipa akiang ah akichiamta hi.
english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

paite: Kumpipa mu ding in Saul tapa Mephibosheth ahong hi. Kumpipa apawtkhiak ni a pan galmuang a ahong pai nawn ni tan in akhete azun kei a, akhamul atan kei a, apuan leng asawp sam kei.
heading: David In Mephibosheth Itna A-ensak
english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa mu dia Jerusalem ahong tun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mephibosheth, bangziak a ka kiang a hong sam lou?" achi hi.
english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka sikha in ahon khem a; na sikha in, kumpipa kiang a hoh ding in ka tuanna ding sabiltung ka van ding, ka chi a; na sikha lah akhe abai ngal a.
english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

paite: Kumpipa ka toupa kiang ah na sikha ahek hi. Himahleh toupa ka kumpipa Pathian angel ahi. Huaiziak in hoih na sak bangbang in hih in.
english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

paite: Ka pa inkote tengteng toupa ka kumpipa ma a thah vek dia kilawm ahi uh. Himahleh na sikha na an umpihte lak ah na pangsak hi. Huaiziak in kumpipa kiang ah thil dang phut ngam lai dia kilawm ka hi maw?" achi hi.
english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Na tungtang thu bangziak a gen nawn nak na hia? Nang leh Ziba gam kihawm un ka chi hi,” achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

paite: Mephibosheth in kumpipa kiang ah, "Eh, ama'n tang vek hen, toupa ka kumpipa lah ama inn mah ah galmuang in ahong pai nawnta ngal a,” achi hi.
english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

paite: Rogelim a pan Gilead mi Barzillai ahong suk a; kumpipa Jordan a pi galkai ding in amah toh Jordan ah ahoh hi.
heading: David In Barzillai Tung Ah Itna Alangsak
english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

paite: Barzillai upapi ahi a, kum sawmgiat a upa ahita. Mahanaim a kumpipa om sung in nek ding apia a, amah mineizoutak ahi.
english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

paite: Kumpipa'n Barzillai kiang ah, "Ka kiang ah hong inla, ka kiang ah Jerusalem ah ka hon vak ding," achi hi.
english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

paite: Barzillai in kumpipa kiang ah, "Jerusalem a kumpipa toh hohtou ding in bang tan ka dam lai dia?
english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

paite: Tu in kum sawmgiat ka hita a; asia leh apha ka khen thei a hia? Na sikha in ka nek-le-dawn, a lim leh lim louh leng a theikak thei a hia? Pasal leh numeite lasak ging leng ka za thei nawn a hia? Huaiziak in na sikha bang ding a toupa ka kumpipa a dia puakgik ka hih maizen ding?
english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

paite: Na sikha in kumpipa toh Jordan galkah lel ka tup ahi. Bang ding in kumpipa'n huchibang in hoih man ahon thuk chitchiat dia?
english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

paite: Hehpih in na sikha hon paisak nawn mai in, ka hon ngen ahi. Ka nu leh ka pa han omna koumau kho ngei ah ka si ding. Himahleh en in, na sikha Chimham; toupa ka kumpipa toh hong galkah henla, atung ah hoih na sak bangbang in hih in,” achi hi.
english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Chimham ka kiang ah agalkah sam dia, hoih na sak bang zel in atung ah ka hih ding. Thil na hon nget peuhmah ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng Jordan gal akah ua, kumpipa leng agalkah hi. Kumpipa'n Barzillai atawp a, avualzawl hi. Huchi in amah amun ah apai nawnta hi.
english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

paite: Huchi in Gilgal ah kumpipa agalkah a, amah toh Chimham agalkah sam hi. Juda mi tengteng in kumpipa api galkah ua, Israel mi leng akimkhat apang uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Kumpipa Tungtang Ah Akisel Uh
english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, Israel mi tengteng kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Bang achia ka unau uh Judah mite'n nang hon gukhia a, kumpipa leh a-inkote leh David mite teng Jordan gal a apikhawm vek mawk uh?" achi uhi.
english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

paite: Judah mi tengteng in Israel mite adawng ua, "Kumpipa ka kinaihpih uh ahih ziak ahi. Bangziak a hiai thu a heh mawk? Kumpipa neih muang a om ka hi mahmah uh maw? Thilpiak banghiamte leng ahon nei a hia?" achi uh.
english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

paite: Israel mite'n Judah mite adawng ua, "Kumpipa ah tan sawm ka nei ua, David ah noute sang in anglaitanna ka nei zaw uh. Bangziak a hon ngaineu maw? Kumpipa pikik nawn sawm masate ka hi kei uh maw?" achi uh. Huchi in Judah mite thu Israel mite thu sang in akhauhzaw hi.
english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
